messages:
nico (LumiScribe): Hey team — we'd like to onboard a multilingual translation model for clinical discharge notes. Spanish + Portuguese first. Text contains PHI. Need ~200ms median latency for our web UX and HSM/KMS for keys. Also want safety evals for hallucination and entity preservation. Who do I loop in?

maria (CS): Hi @nico — thanks. I'm maria (CS) — we can run intake. Can you drop a sample (anonymized) dataset + expected QPS? Also any region/legal constraints?

nico (LumiScribe): Thanks @maria. We can provide de-identified samples but would like guidance on tokenization/PHI handling. Target ~50 rps peak, ~10 rps steady. US & EU only.

jamal (Solutions): cc @maria @lee @tara. 50 rps with 200ms median => likely Dedicated or Private. If PHI + HSM, Private w/ customer-managed KMS is standard.

lee (ML Eng): Quick Q: what model capability do you need — literal translate vs clinical-preserving paraphrase? That changes evals. Also do you have sequence length distribution?

nico (LumiScribe): Primary goal = faithful translation, preserve PHI tokens (we WANT them preserved as-is, e.g., names masked by downstream). Examples will show ~400 tokens avg, tail to 1500.

jamal (Solutions): Proposed config (back-of-envelope):
```yaml
deployment: private
capacity: dedicated-pool
model_family: multilingual-13b
quantization: int8
hsm: true
throughput_target_rps: 50
latency_slo_ms: 200
```
This keeps latency tight and lets us enable prefix caching.

tara (Security): @nico thanks. For PHI we need: customer-managed KMS/HSM, audit logs retention, and vetting of pipeline for tokenization/PII redaction. We'll need a data flow diagram + contract clause for PHI handling.

maria (CS): I'll open intake and schedule an enablement call. @jamal can you scope a short safety eval plan (hallucination + entity preservation) and a prompt suite? We should also flag renewal impact — Private+HSM ups cost. @nico any timeline?

nico (LumiScribe): Ideally live in 8 weeks. Budget is flexible but we need clear cost estimate before committing.

jamal (Solutions): We'll run two evals: (1) entity-preservation (exact token match rate) (2) hallucination score vs reference. We can use Redwood Optimize to baseline current open models. I'll create the eval playbook.

lee (ML Eng): For the evals send ~200 labeled pairs per language (ES/PT/EN) and a few edge cases with long tail sequences. We'll test quantized variants for perf/quality tradeoffs.

maria (CS): Intake ticket created: CS-13442 — assigned to maria. Scheduling poll for enablement this week. @ops-bot can you attach cost estimate stub?

ops-bot: Intake CS-13442 created by maria. Linked: https://redwood.internal/cs/CS-13442.

maria (CS): Action items: 1) @nico upload sample + expected QPS + compliance contacts 2) @jamal draft eval plan and cost range 3) @lee run perf/quality matrix on candidate models 4) @tara security checklist + required docs. I'll follow up with calendar invite. :calendar:

nico (LumiScribe): Got it — uploading samples now. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

jamal (Solutions): One more note: if low-latency tail is critical, we can enable `reserved-burst` and warm KV cache for common prefixes. I'll include that in config notes.

lee (ML Eng): Also recommend offline canary with a small percentage of traffic before full cutover. Keeps rollback fast.

maria (CS): thanks everyone — I'll post updates in this thread and on the intake ticket.

nico (LumiScribe): Thanks team :heart:
